message.content: [罪名]过失致人死亡罪;投放危险物质罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on the facts: The defendant placed a bag of pale yellow granules (actually sodium nitrite) into sugar bowl, thinking it's sugar. 13 people ate, 1 died. This is likely "故意杀人罪" (intentional homicide) or "过失致人死亡罪"? The defendant thought it was sugar, so no intent to kill. Could be "过失致人死亡罪" (negligent homicide) and also "危害公共安全罪" (endangering public safety) maybe "投放危险物质罪". Chinese criminal law: Article 115 (危害公共安全罪) includes "投放、散布有毒有害物质" causing危害. Also "故意伤害罪" for injuries. Since death occurred, could be "过失致人死亡罪" (Article 233). Also "投放危险物质罪" (Article 115). The facts: He mistakenly thought it was sugar, but still placed a dangerous substance. That is negligence. So charges: "过失致人死亡罪" and "投放危险物质罪" (危害公共安全罪). Also "故意伤害罪"? No intent. So answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡罪;投放危险物质罪<eoa>
